description: Leadership Education in Neurodevelopmental and related Disabilities (LEND), is focusing on building capacity to serve individuals with disabilities across the lifespan. By supporting professionals in the field, self-advocates, and family members of individuals with disabilities, we are working to improve outcomes and foster independence within the disability community. This allows for individuals with disabilities to participate more within their communities, reducing the need for long-term high support.
